major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Dance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open a Dance only when Secret Technique is ready, except the second one inside Shadow Blades, and macro it with Shuriken Storm so no global is lost.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 185313 is the cast id; 185422 is the matching self aura used by the buff-based rules.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Blades
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send Shadow Blades with a Shadow Dance charge in hand so two Dance windows fit inside it, and fire your trinket and potion on the same window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 121471 is both the cast and the self aura; 279043 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Secret Technique
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for Shadow Dance and cast it as early in the window as you can, letting a Darkest Night Eviscerate go first on low target counts.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 280719 is the row carrying the 25s tooltip cooldown; 280720 and 282449 share the name with zero casts and look like the clone damage components. No Secret Technique casts were recorded under any id in the sampled parses, so talent_gated is set to keep zero casts from reading as never used.

major_cooldowns.name: Goremaw's Bite
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it on cooldown right before Shadow Dance, or inside the window while Ancient Arts is down, and empty it before the fight ends.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 426591 is the cast; 426593 is the enemy aura of the same name.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown at low combo points for a free Shadowstrike, and to re-cycle Deathstalker's Mark when Quietus Celeris procs pull it out of alignment.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1856 is the cast; 11327 is the self aura.

rule.description: Open with Shadowstrike into Shadow Dance and Shadow Blades
rule.action: Open from Stealth with Shadowstrike, then chain Shadow Dance into Shadow Blades with your trinket and potion.

rule.description: Secret Technique always inside Shadow Dance
rule.action: Hold Secret Technique for Shadow Dance and fire it as your first finisher in the window.

rule.description: Shadow Blades paired with Shadow Dance
rule.action: Stack Shadow Blades onto a Shadow Dance window and bank a Dance charge for a second one inside it.
Send Goremaw's Bite right before Shadow Dance or inside the window, never between them.

rule.description: Shadowstrike, not Backstab, inside Shadow Dance
rule.action: Build with Shadowstrike while Shadow Dance is up and keep Backstab for outside it.
Build to your combo point cap before Eviscerate and only spend early with Darkest Night up.
Dump your combo points before Vanish so the Shadowstrike behind it is not wasted.

rule.description: Black Powder as the multi-target finisher
rule.action: Switch your finisher to Black Powder in multi-target and stay on Eviscerate on low target counts.
Make Eviscerate your next finisher as soon as Darkest Night lights up.
Cast Eviscerate as your next finisher the moment Slice and Dice drops.
